Simmons played [[college basketball]] for the [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona Wildcats]]. ==High school career== [[File: 20160330 MCDAAG Kobi Simmons dunk.jpg|190px|thumb|right|Simmons dunks the Basketball at the [[2016 McDonald's All-American Game]]]] Simmons attended [[St. Francis Schools (Atlanta area, Georgia)|St. Francis]] in [[Milton, Georgia]]. In his freshman year, Simmons averaged 14.1 points, 3.9 assists, 2.7 rebounds, and 2.0 steals per game. As a sophomore in 2013–14, he averaged 17.4 points, 4.8 assists, and 3.5 rebounds per game. As a junior, Simmons averaged 21.2 [[points per game]], 4.2 [[assist (basketball)|assists per game]], and 2.9 [[rebounds per game]] in 32 games. In the summer of his junior year, Simmons played in the 2015 [[Under Armour]] Elite 24 Game in [[Brooklyn, New York]]. He was later invited to camps such as the [[Adidas]] Nations and Adidas Euro-camps. As a senior, Simmons averaged 26.0 points, 4.0 rebounds and 4.0 assists per outing. In his last game for the Knights, he scored 36 points, including seven three-pointers in the semi-final game against Milton High School. Throughout his high school career, Simmons led St. Francis to 100 victories, two state championships and Four state championship appearances. On January 16, Simmons committed to [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona]].{{Cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/14584170/kobi-simmons-no-18-espn-100-commits-arizona-wildcats|title=Kobi Simmons commits to Wildcats|last=Borzello|first=Jeff|date=January 16, 2016|work=[[ESPN]]|access-date=November 29, 2019}} In January 2016, Simmons was named a [[McDonald's All-American Game|McDonald's All-American]]{{Cite news|url=http://www.tucsonnewsnow.com/story/30988819/arizona-commit-kobi-simmons-is-a-mcdonalds-all-american|title=Arizona commit Kobi Simmons is a McDonald's All-American|last=Gimino|first=Anthony|access-date=May 26, 2017|language=en}} and played in the [[2016 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2016 McDonald's All-American Game]] on March 30 at the [[United Center]] in Chicago, where he recorded 12 points, 2 assists, and 1 steal in a 114–107 loss to the West Team. Simmons was rated as a five-star recruit and ranked 20th in the Class of 2016 according to [[ESPN]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/college-sports/basketball/recruiting/player/_/id/183236/kobi-simmons|title=Kobi Simmons --- Basketball Recruiting --- Player Profiles|website=ESPN.com|access-date=March 1, 2016}} He also earned Atlanta Journal-Constitution Player of the Year honors.{{cite web|url=http://highschoolsports.blog.ajc.com/2016/03/25/st-francis-guard-kobi-simmons-player-of-the-year/|title=AJC Player of the Year: St. Francis' Kobi Simmons {{!}} Prep Zone: High School Sports blog|last=Holcomb|first=Todd|access-date=May 26, 2017|archive-date=January 21, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180121215946/http://highschoolsports.blog.ajc.com/2016/03/25/st-francis-guard-kobi-simmons-player-of-the-year/|url-status=dead}} His number has been retired at St. Francis.{{Cite web |date=August 22, 2018 |title=Former Arizona Wildcat Kobi Simmons jersey retired at St. Francis HS |url=https://zonazealots.com/2018/08/22/former-arizona-wildcat-kobi-simmons-jersey-retired-at-st-francis-hs/ |access-date=October 25, 2022 |website=Zona Zealots |language=en-US}} ==College career== Simmons played one season of college basketball for [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona]]. On November 11, 2016, Simmons scored 18 points, tying the most points in an NCAA debut for an Arizona player in a decade, leading the Wildcats to victory in a 65–63 win against No. 12 ranked [[Michigan State Spartans men's basketball|Michigan State]] in the [[Armed Forces Classic]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400915062|title=No.10 Arizona beats No.12 Michigan State in final seconds|work=ESPN.com|date=November 11, 2016|access-date=November 29, 2019}} On January 21, 2017, Simmons recorded 20 points, 6 rebounds, and 5 assists in a 96–85 win against No. 3 ranked [[UCLA Bruins men's basketball|UCLA]]. As the No. 2 seed in the [[2017 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament]], Arizona defeated [[Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball|Colorado]] in the quarter-finals and UCLA in the semi-finals. On March 11, 2017, Simmons and Arizona defeated [[Oregon Ducks men's basketball|Oregon]] 83–80 to win the Pac-12 Conference Championship. The Wildcats entered the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 2 Seed in the West Region, where Arizona defeated [[North Dakota Fighting Hawks men's basketball|North Dakota]] in the first round and [[Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball|St. Mary's]] in the second round before losing to [[Xavier Musketeers men's basketball|Xavier]] in the Sweet Sixteen. Simmons appeared in 37 games (19 starts) as a freshman and averaged 8.7 points, 1.6 rebounds and 2.0 assists in 23.5 minutes per game. On April 5, 2017, Simmons declared for the NBA draft, forgoing his final three years of college eligibility.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/19088128/kobi-simmons-arizona-wildcats-enter-nba-draft|title=Arizona's Kobi Simmons leaving after freshman season for NBA|work=ESPN.com|date=April 5, 2017|access-date=July 1, 2017}} ==Professional career== ===Memphis Grizzlies (2017–2018)=== Simmons split playing time between the Grizzlies and their new G League affiliate, the [[Memphis Hustle]]. His NBA debut with the Grizzlies came on November 29, 2017, in a 95–104 loss to the [[San Antonio Spurs]].{{Cite news|url=http://www.commercialappeal.com/story/sports/nba/grizzlies/2017/11/29/san-antonio-spurs-104-grizzlies-95-5-things-we-learned-lamarcus-aldridge/904993001/|title=San Antonio Spurs 104, Memphis Grizzlies 95: 5 things we learned|work=The Commercial Appeal|access-date=November 30, 2017|language=en}} He played a total of 32 games (12 starts) for the Grizzlies, averaging 6.1 points, 2.1 assists and 1.6 rebounds per contest. He converted all 25 of his 25 free throws during his NBA stint.{{Cite web |title=Kobi Simmons |url=https://www.nba.com/player/1628424/kobi-simmons/ |access-date=October 25, 2022 |website=www.nba.com |language=en}} Simmons was waived by the Grizzlies on August 28, 2018.{{Cite news|url=http://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grizzlies-waive-kobi-simmons-180828/|title=Grizzlies waive Kobi Simmons|work=NBA.com|access-date=August 28, 2018}} In G League play, Simmons averaged 15.1 points, 3.9 assists and 2.7 rebounds in 26 outings for the Memphis Hustle.{{Cite web |title=2017-18 Memphis
